title: AI News Daily — September 8, 2026
summary: Anthropic locked in $517 billion in compute leases over the past 11 months — nearly triple the figure it gave investors in December — ahead of an expected IPO. Meanwhile, Mistral raised Europe's largest-ever tech funding round, hitting a €21 billion valuation. And Anthropic quietly walked away from a $6 billion bid for chip-efficiency startup Decart.
